PLANNED on Anthony's word, 2026-09-14, from the session plan he confirmed ("record as proposed"; "two walks, one increment"). NO VERSION NUMBER BY DESIGN (dec:idea-a-planned-increment-is-named-by-content-not-by-number).

THE THEME. Three field reports arrived on 2026-09-14 and they are one class: a mechanism the design already holds fails to reach the moment it exists for. The register rule exists, is lint-checked, and reflow2's own nouns still reached a person verbatim. The orientation skill exists and a management progress deck was written from a checklist file without the design being read. The cause discipline exists and an agent asked the owner whether to record causes at all. In every case the tool or rule was present and nothing keyed it to the words a person reads or the moment a claim is made.

ORDER, as ruled:
1. Root-cause on reflow2 jargon reaching the user unfiltered by the lens (his explicit ask) — fact:reflow2-jargon-reaches-the-user-unfiltered-by-the-lens-a-work-session-said-structural-findings-and-undispositioned-drift-to-a-person. Subject cap:the-register-rule-reaches-the-words. The leading candidate to discriminate, not assume: the lens governs prose the skills write, while the offending words were reply field names read out in a closing summary no skill governs. The baseball coach is the test.
2. Root-cause on the hxm_program status deck — fact:field-report-hxm-a-progress-deck-was-written-from-a-checklist-and-recency-and-the-design-was-read-only-after-a-challenge. A SECOND walk on the same bones (ruled: two walks, one increment), because the class is shared with fact:the-root-cause-skill-is-demanded-by-no-tool-and-named-by-no-trigger-so-it-loads-only-by-luck: a trigger keyed on the agent's internal state loads only by luck. After the walk, the three ideas it produced are put to Anthony for promotion, parking or rejection; the walk says which of them addresses the cause.
3. Root-cause on fix_without_recorded_cause — fact:a-work-project-answered-fix-without-recorded-cause-and-twenty-of-twenty-one-fixes-were-checksum-dispositions-wearing-the-nearest-label — then its three sub-items in the order already recorded there: measure which path labelled twenty checksum dispositions defect_fix and fix it at the source (resync is the right label); rewrite the gap text as a standing rule with a triage recipe and sweep other detector texts that offer declining a DesignRule as an option; exclude acceptance-minted events by construction.

WHY THIS ORDER. Anthony's ruling of 2026-09-07 (dec:v0520-takes-the-field-feedback-triage-first-then-the-cement-measure) puts field feedback ahead of instruments because it is the only input from someone using reflow2 on their own design. Jargon goes first among the three because it is the one that loses a user outright.

WHAT IS NOT IN IT. No new instrument, no new detector unless a walk names one as the fix at the cause. Not the three remaining source-reading analyses (clone detection, protocol enumeration, the profile survey): those wait on Anthony's definitions and are the next increment, epoch:planned-the-three-source-reading-analyses. Not the rulings only he can give (the eleven decision_overtaken_by_promotion findings; dec:idea-should-an-edge-write-report-and-preserve-what-it-replaced-the-way-a-node-write-does; the six ideas parked at his instruction). Not the loop housekeeping (36 unsurfaced gaps, 92 structural defects, 3 unproven capabilities, 2 unreconciled built capabilities, one ghost claim), which is one pass beside the increment, not part of it.

Each walk runs the root-cause skill in full: symptom as observation, precedent, candidates generated from the design, a measurement that could refute the favourite, the class, the fix at the cause with its failing-first test.
properties.name: PLANNED — the mechanism reaches the moment: three field reports of 2026-09-14 root-caused and fixed at the cause
